about: Dwayne W. Smith is an attorney who represents clients in the Fort Worth, Texas area. Dwayne Smith is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Dwayne Smith chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended The University of Texas School of Law and graduated in 2008. Dwayne Smith passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2008.
He represents clients with Family Law issues in Texas.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Dwayne Smith has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
